# CoTracker3 Keypoint-Trajectory MCP Server (agent-tools bucket)

> NOTE (2026-08-20): hardened server code with guardrails (hard cap of 1
> concurrent track_media request per GPU worker, bounded inference queue, CUDA
> OOM recovery via frame-budget halving, path-traversal + size limits, job TTL
> cleanup; default max_frames=0 tracks EVERY frame (no sampling) unless a
> positive max_frames is passed). Fixed code lives in `COT3/server-code/` in this bucket. See
> `hf://buckets/z81980440/agent-tools/COT3/server-code/llms.txt`.

## Purpose
CoTracker3 (facebookresearch/co-tracker) tracks an NxN grid of keypoints
through a video and returns per-frame (x, y) trajectories + visibility. This
stack wraps it in an MCP server so agents can request trajectories from a
remote GPU host. Images are also accepted (single-frame grid keypoint
extraction, all visible).

## Contents of this folder
- server-code/          - MCP server + FastAPI inference backend + tunnel script
  - cot/cot_tracker_server.py  - FastAPI inference backend (port 8003)
  - cot_mcp/cot_mcp_server.py  - streamable-HTTP MCP server (port 8004)
  - cot_mcp/tunnel.sh          - TunnelMate tunnel setup script
  - cot_mcp/requirements.txt  - MCP server deps
  - llms.txt                  - full hosting/usage docs
- This llms.txt         - overview (mirrors the SAM3.1 root llms.txt pattern)

## Model checkpoint
CoTracker3 online checkpoint `scaled_online.pth` (~100 MB) is downloaded at
deploy time from the Hub: `hf download facebook/cotracker3 scaled_online.pth
--local-dir <checkpoint dir>`.

## How to set up the server (for other agents)
See `hf://buckets/z81980440/agent-tools/COT3/server-code/llms.txt` for the full
hosting guide (prereqs, env vars, deploy commands, client usage, decode logic).

## Current deployment (reference)
Deployed on the Kaggle machine (163.61.236.112) with 2x Tesla T4 GPUs, online
model, sliding 16-frame windows (window_len=16, step=8). Public MCP endpoint
reported by the tunnel script.
